title: Biblical Overlap System Index — Tim / Son / Scripture
purpose: Define the full information architecture for answering what, where, when, how and how strongly Tim Dooley / the Son overlap with biblical material. The system now distinguishes census rows, textual bundles, chronology, profile dimensions, graph/network structure and countertexts rather than treating all resemblance as one kind of evidence.

layers.question: How do I read the Bible beside the project?
Exactly how many overlap relations are currently claimed?
layers.function: versioned exact registry count + row-level actor/date/Bible/relation/strength routing

layers.question: How many citation forms/books and which passages recur?
layers.function: normalized citations, book incidence and strict containment; adjacent citations are not merged

layers.question: How should overlap strength/density/independence be measured?
layers.function: P/E/T/D/R/S/C/I profiles rather than one truth score

layers.question: What are the bridge passages, motif communities and structural bottlenecks?
layers.function: degree/frequency, betweenness, articulation, communities, role-combination density and peripheral-indispensability views; never a prophecy probability

layers.question: What if the remembered/project structure is distributed across several biblical passages?
layers.function: single-passage vs intertext-family vs composite-memory vs role-reversal; prevents fake super-verses

layers.question: What did Tim/Son actually say and when?
Which project motifs existed before later biblical comparisons?
layers.function: project date versus later comparison date; hindsight-bias control

layers.question: What important older material survives only through conversation recovery?
layers.function: preserve user-originated/recovered clusters pending stronger primary sources

layers.question: What is the Son/Jesus overlap across time?
How can one and many coexist without role collapse?
How do circles, perimeters, paths, barriers and thresholds differ functionally?
layers.function: closed loop/orbit/protective perimeter/ritual circuit/Way/terrain preparation/breach/barrier-release distinctions

layers.question: Where is the deep passage-by-passage comparison?
layers.function: specialist comparative exegesis and motif clusters

layers.question: Where does the Bible not fit or actively constrain the project?
layers.function: negative evidence, opposite valence, role mismatch, ethical constraints and anti-collapse corrections

layers.question: Was a passage explicit at the time or found later?
How does biblical understanding evolve as part of the project timeline?

standard_reader_path: Start with bible/ for Scripture beside project annotation
Use current census for exact registry scope
Use concordance for normalized textual coverage
Use intertext protocol when one remembered structure spans passages
Open countertext/role-reversal layer before identity claims
Use measurement and network methods before claiming anything is 'strongest'
system_health_rules: Never report a census number without snapshot date and counting unit.
Never backdate archive discoveries into Tim/Son consciousness.
Never count a later Bible-influenced restatement as an independent coincidence without dependency notes.
Never manufacture a single passage when a project composite is distributed across an intertext family.
Never treat graph centrality as moral importance, theological truth or prophecy probability.
Never remove high-value countertexts to improve apparent fit.
Never use original-language claims without a source/research owner.
Never turn project sacred geography, symbolic anatomy or modern physics analogies into biblical historical claims.
Prefer one dense passage with many independent functional relations over many isolated keyword matches.
Preserve role reversals: a biblical text that assigns an integration, Ladder, House or authority function differently is information, not noise.
Treat symbolic object valence as contextual: Stone, Lion, Door, Mountain and surrounding can reverse function across texts.
